featured_title: Colonial Country Club Fort Myers FL: Golf Village or Lakes Village in 2026?
featured_excerpt: Golf Village dues run ~$10,335/yr with bundled golf. Lakes Village runs ~$4,880/yr with none. Here's how to pick the right side of Colonial Country Club.
